lcc_original: 潔淨的畜類、和不潔淨的畜類、飛鳥和爬在地上的各樣昆蟲，
notes: LCC splits UNV's single word 昆蟲 into verbal 爬 + nominal 昆蟲. The Hebrew for this clause is וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר-רֹמֵשׂ עַל-הָאֲדָמָה ('all that creep upon the ground') — there is no separate noun for 'insects'; H7430 is purely the Qal participle verb. WH07430+WTH8802 are therefore assigned to 爬 (the verbal/participial form), leaving 昆蟲 unannotated as a Chinese gloss with no direct Hebrew lexeme.

LCC restructures the final clause as 爬在地上的各樣昆蟲 (relative clause before noun) vs. UNV's 地上一切的昆蟲 (place-phrase before noun). WAH05921 maps to 在 (= עַל, upon) and WH0127 maps to 地上 (= הָאֲדָמָה, ground).

Both {<WAH0834>} occurrences remain implicit: (1) in 和{<WAH0834>}不潔淨的 the relative function is absorbed into the adjective structure; (2) in 的{<WAH0834>}各樣 the 的 particle carries the relative link but is a structural particle rather than an explicit lexical word, so braces are retained per Rule 4.
